title: When you go downtown (to midtown) #littleshopofhorrors #broadway #off...
transcript: Yeah, sing it, child. Eat all your lunches at the hot dog spot. The bosses take your money and they make your work. And up till you hit him to a million dollar, that's when you go. All my life I've always been forced. Jeg Får Kniv Av he took me and gave me shelter, of bread and a job. Treats me like dirt, calls me a slob, which I am. Get out of here. الله اكبر الله اكبر
